sloka: अद्वारेण मःआतेजा हौमान् कपिसत्तमः ।प्रविश्य नगरीम् लङ्काम् कपिराजहितम्करः ॥५-४-२॥
transliteration: advāreṇa maḥātejā haumān kapisattamaḥ ।praviśya nagarīm laṅkām kapirājahitamkaraḥ ॥5-4-2॥

translations.english: Hanuman, a devotee of the king of monkeys entered the city of Lanka placing his left foot first on the forehead of the city and proceeded (by tradition one enters the enemy's dwelling by placing the left foot first to cause defeat of the enemy).
